name: Companion Defence Laboratory
backstory: A nimble companion machine and a military specialist share an uneasy arena collection. The workshop funds distinct close and distant jobs through balanced partner upgrades.
strategy_personality: A companion android and a military android create a useful contrast within one technology lineage. Preserve each selected film body, hair, costume, and human-like face; do not turn either into a generic plated soldier. This is a collection of rivals proposed for the arena. Choose one M3GAN chassis and outfit before production, so upgrades or alternate bodies do not inflate the roster.

robots.name: M3GAN
robots.art_brief:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: Armoured Souls individual robot game portrait. Generate ONE square 1:1 image of ONE complete source-faithful robot, not an original substitute.
Scene/backdrop: quiet charcoal-to-black industrial studio gradient, subtle dark floor and restrained low haze.
Style/medium: premium realistic industrial sci-fi hard-surface 3D rendering, believable metal, fine scratches and restrained paint wear, preserving source geometry and colours. Match the established Armoured Souls portrait collection.
Composition: three-quarter view, complete full body with head, all feet/legs and equipment contained in frame, centered at about 80% of square canvas with at least 5% clear margin around every extremity. Readable silhouette at 512px.
Lighting: neutral soft key, cool upper-right rim light, controlled cinematic contrast and subtle source-appropriate sensors.
Constraints: one character, no additional figures, no collage/grid, no text/captions, watermark, UI or border, no firing or explosions. Keep canonical proportions and anatomy; do not add humanoid arms to walkers or astromechs. Full-resolution square master for 512x512 WebP export.

Subject: M3GAN using her original 2023 lifelike doll body and signature outfit: long honey-blond hair, recognizable pale doll face with blue eyes, beige pleated dress over a striped long-sleeve undershirt, oversized striped bow at the collar, opaque white tights, black Mary Jane shoes. Calm composed standing full body, arms relaxed, no injury or violence, preserve the character's source clothing and proportions, no military armour or exposed skin beyond source head/hands.
Metadata only, do not render text: #171 slot 1 M3GAN.
robots.refinement_note: No verified Hone/Augment combination exists for this final weapon in the supplied references; Duo does not buy Sharpen/Forge. The empty plan is intentional.
robots.equipment_interpretation: M3GAN fills the paired contact attacker role. Its source body and selected portrait are retained. Arena main/offhand allocations can use fitted mounts or tool adapters; extra limbs, integrated source weapons and alternate forms grant no additional slots or combat effects.
robots.combat_rationale: Sprinter tuning supports the melee equipment role; offensive stance and a 10% yield threshold implement its pressure or survival priority. Range follows the equipped weapons at both stages.
robots.tuning_plan: Use the existing Duo strategy tuning rules with the Sprinter Build_Focus and its free pool; equipment refinements do not replace robot tuning.
robots.design_basis: New arena build authored for this collection using supplied equipment prices, hand compatibility and verified refinement examples. Original source identity and final artwork remain authoritative for appearance.

source_notes:
**Franchise:** M3GAN — film continuity through M3GAN 2.0  
**Strategy:** Duo · **Target roster:** 2 robots

**Proposed robots:** M3GAN; AMELIA.

**Direction:** A companion android and a military android create a useful contrast within one technology lineage. Preserve each selected film body, hair, costume, and human-like face; do not turn either into a generic plated soldier. This is a collection of rivals proposed for the arena. Choose one M3GAN chassis and outfit before production, so upgrades or alternate bodies do not inflate the roster.

References: [Universal's M3GAN 2.0 trailer and synopsis identifying AMELIA](https://www.universalstudios.com/videos/1FeiTZMtwLA/).

**Production edition:** M3GAN original 2023 companion body and AMELIA M3GAN 2.0 2025 infiltration body; same film technology lineage.  
**Catalogue key:** `companion-defence-laboratory`
purchasing_plan: Open with both robots. Alternate stage-1 equipment investment between slots 1 and 2; finish both final loadouts before refining. Visit both robots in each Hone pass, then each Augment pass, buying Workshop L1/L3 only as required. No Sharpen or Forge purchases.

equipment_budget.excludes: Frames, facilities, training, repairs, upkeep, discounts and resale; stage-1 total replaces stage-0 gear and is not a simultaneous equipment inventory.
